fault.rootCause: A scene or overlay initializer can restore cadence 2 after the player timestep hooks and payload are already installed. The v6 install-only guard then fails closed, leaving approximately 30 semantic updates across approximately 60 emulated frames.
fault.privateRecoveryFixture: Slot 8 was saved before reinstall with the patched hooks active and cadence reset to 2. No save-state bytes or path are published.

runtimePatch.installRegion: The existing exact-original guards install the v6 player movement, speed, timer, control-timer and Player-animation hooks plus cadence 1.

maintenanceRegion.guards: All five exact patched hook words, all 62 player payload words, all 12 animation payload words, and cadence exact value 2.
maintenanceRegion.failClosed: Any incomplete hook or payload state, cadence 1, or any unexpected cadence value produces no maintenance write.

thorRecovery.immediatePostLoad: The private v6 fault fixture loaded successfully while paused. All five patched hook words were present; the timing sampler had not yet accumulated a valid wall-clock window.

limitations: This closes the observed cadence 2 reset after scene, overlay or save-state restoration only when the complete expected v7 hook and payload state is present.
The maintenance region deliberately does not repair hooks or payload. Every emitted payload word is guarded; an incomplete or unknown state remains unchanged and therefore fail-closed.
The v7 maintenance addition does not change the v6 player timestep payload or its same-state movement, vertical, timer and animation evidence.
Particles, non-player actors, cutscenes, audio continuity, broad gameplay behavior, RetroAchievements Casual interaction and the 60-minute stability gate remain open.
No ROM, save-state bytes, device serial, private capture or private path is included.
